messages.subject: Adding a legend to facet_grid...
parts:
I have a facet grid with 2 variables. Here's my code:

p<-qplot(Coefficient, data=x, geom="histogram") + facet_grid(Treatment
~ Age.Class)

I'm wondering how to add a legend detailing what "Treatment" and
"Age.Class" are.

Thanks,

Adam

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: Adding a legend to facet_grid...
parts:
I think I know what Adam means, and I think it's more a drawback of
how both lattice & ggplot2 label the facets while making the variable
determining the labels implicit.

For example, if your facet variable is called "Flower" with levels
"Rose" and "Daisy", the standard lattice/ggplot2 display of the facet
labels is to label the "Rose" facet as "Rose" and the "Daisy" facet as
"Daisy", leaving the fact that we're talking about the "Flower"
variable implicit.

To solve this I often re-label my factors to make the source factor
explicit to the graph reader:
levels(Flower) = c('Flower = Rose','Flower = Daisy')

An alternative is to specify in a figure caption the variable
determining the facets.
